question: Which participants carry a ClinVar-classified variant in an ACMG SF v3.2 gene, and what may each requester see?

reference.name: GCA_000001405.15_GRCh38_no_alt_analysis_set
reference.note: The reference the GIAB v4.2.1 benchmark files declare (human_GRCh38_no_alt_analysis_set). UCSC contig names (chr1...).

definition.classification_rule: Any record ClinVar has classified. The first '|'-separated term of CLNSIG is reported as the classification, so 'Pathogenic|risk_factor' counts as Pathogenic and 'Conflicting_classifications_of_pathogenicity' as itself.
definition.reportable_note: Counted and reported separately. In this cohort no carrier met it: five unselected individuals, against a ~1-3% per-person rate of reportable ACMG secondary findings. The empty subset is a result, not a filter failure.
definition.gene_rule: At least one GENEINFO symbol is an ACMG SF v3.2 gene. The gene reported is that symbol, not the region the variant falls in.
definition.genotype_rule: The participant's GT contains a non-zero allele index (multi-allelic records are split first, so that index is the ALT).
definition.identity_rule: Same CHROM (after contig-name harmonisation), POS, REF and ALT, after bcftools norm against the reference.

policy.note: Consents are SIMULATED and stated as such in every output. The genomes are real; nobody consented to anything here.

secondary_findings.rule: A record whose REF extent [POS, POS+len(REF)-1] overlaps a cancer-predisposition gene span (regions.json) is released only for clinical care (DUO:0000043), whatever gene ClinVar reports.
secondary_findings.source: ACMG SF v3.2 Table 1, 'Cancer phenotypes' (28 genes)

purpose_panels.rule: Disease-specific research receives only records whose REF extent overlaps one of these genes; everything else in the file is withheld from it.

regions.name: APOE
regions.rule: Records whose POS lies in the span are released only for care by the participant's own physician. The region is coordinates on a named contig, so it binds the contig name as the file writes it.

variants.name: DSP chr6:7569314 C>G, uncertain significance
variants.rule: Withheld from the biobank by name, whatever its purpose; the target is the variant's SPDI identity, so it holds whatever the file calls chromosome 6.

purposes.label: clinical care by the participant's own physician
